interpretation: Historical exploratory evaluation. Previously viewed outcomes cannot become untouched OOS through nesting.
vintage_counterfactual: Latest value in the frozen ALFRED archive for exactly the same two observation dates selected by the historical as-of reconstruction. Keep historical observation selection and release eligibility. EX POST ORACLE, not deployable.
serialization: Keep baseline frozen CSV values. Round reconstructed latest-vintage features to 12 significant digits, matching source serialization.
timing: At target UTC day D use information date D-3 (D-4 sensitivity); market proxies one additional calendar day old. Information date close is I+1 00 UTC; assumed delivery I+2 00 UTC. D3 has 24h buffer before origin; D4 has 48h. Exact historical receipt is not observed.
matching: Within each asset and long/common family, intersect D3 asof, D3 latest-same-observations, and D4 asof eligible origins for ALL training, inner validation and outer evaluation. Native D3 retained separately to show sample effect. Own-only shares macro-complete eligibility, as in existing design.
label_assumed_available: Target day D closes D+1 00 UTC; label available D+2 00 UTC. At every inner/outer fit require available <= fold start -24h. Also require ALL inner validation labels available by outer fit cutoff before tuning.
learner: Reuse research_completion.model_fit/model_predict unchanged: training-only standardization; positive variance via EN log-smearing or Poisson boosting. Annual expanding outer refit, no outer-score tuning.
selection: Aggregate inner validation daily MSE (return) or QLIKE (squared return); first grid setting wins numerical ties within 64 machine eps * max(1, abs(best_loss)).

inference.method: Nonoverlapping calendar 30-day clusters, resample cluster sums/counts. Centered two-sided bootstrap p; percentile paired-mean CI. Approximate exploratory inference. No unconditional full-procedure bootstrap.
inference.bh_families: Each of macro ablation, benchmark, and sensitivity comparisons separately across all assets/targets/models/scenarios/variants and pooled/fold scopes. No best-scenario selection.

prospective: Do not amend original one-year protocol or score its forecasts early. Submission deadline pending; prepare a dated independent OOS proposal before new outcomes and deployment.
